layers.description: Original frozen audit labels, LLM-generated; image grounding unverified
Independent human re-audit A (blind, image-grounded; 137 binary + 48 taxonomy)
Independent human re-audit B (blind, image-grounded; 137 binary + 48 taxonomy)
Second-LLM audit-reliability check (MiMo-V2.5, image-grounded prompts); degenerate (option-1 collapse) — reported as a reliability finding
GPT-5.6 Sol audit-reliability check (corrected one-item CLEAN/AMBIGUOUS 137 run + 48 taxonomy); modest human alignment (kappa 0.336 vs human A)
Gemini Spark audit-reliability check (one-item CLEAN/AMBIGUOUS 137 run + 48 taxonomy); binary CLEAN collapse 126/137, taxonomy collapse toward clear_image_model_reasoning_failure

usage_note: All ratings are per VSR test-set example id. The automated audit's labels predate this resource and are retained as the frozen v1; human and MiMo layers are additive. Derived from VSR (cambridgeltl/vsr_random) statements and COCO images (images.cocodataset.org).
